##### Project general facts

Shione is a beachfront residential development by Beyond within the Siora masterplan, taking its name from a Japanese expression evoking the sound of the tide. The project brings together two sculptural residential buildings joined by a landscaped podium, with signature horizontal bridges, sculpted balconies and expansive glazing shaping a silhouette that echoes the rhythm of the sea. The collection spans one-bedroom apartments, one-bedroom residences with a study, two- and three-bedroom homes and a Signature Collection of three- and four-bedroom duplexes with double-height terraces, while corner glazing and dual-aspect layouts in selected residences frame open coastal views. Ground-level retail and dining pavilions complete the composition.

Life at Shione centres on a Japanese-inspired podium where reflective pools, cascading water and layered planting flow through a sequence of gardens, from a Zen garden and meditation lawn to a geometric Japanese terrace and raised seating platforms. An elevated adults' pool with an infinity edge, sun decks and a canopied jacuzzi sits above a second pool fed by a waterfall, and residents enjoy direct access to the beach. Wellness is covered by an indoor gym and an outdoor fitness area, while families have dedicated children's spaces with a shallow pool and an adventure rock play area. A residents' chef's kitchen and a residents' lounge with spaces for recreation and gathering support social life, and jogging and cycling tracks across the island extend the active lifestyle beyond the podium.

Interiors follow a minimalist coastal language of warm timber, natural stone and soft textures, with large openings bringing light and sea views deep into the living spaces. Apartments feature porcelain flooring, laminate cabinetry with bronze glass accents and kitchens with integrated appliances and stone-effect countertops, while the Signature Collection duplexes are finished in veined marble, carved timber cabinetry, wooden flooring in the bedrooms and brushed bronze details. Loose furniture is left to the owner's own choice.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Islands is a coastal destination off the Deira waterfront, formed by a group of islands that combine beachfront living, hospitality and leisure. The district is known for long stretches of open beach, landscaped parks, waterfront promenades, marinas and a wide collection of resort hotels, giving it a relaxed island character while staying closely linked to the historic heart of the city.

Road and sea connections place the Gold Souq metro station, Dubai International Airport, the Dubai Frame, DIFC, Downtown Dubai and Business Bay within a comfortable drive. The islands themselves offer landscaped parks, golf courses and jogging and cycling routes along the shore, while the established neighbourhoods of Deira cover everyday needs.

Dubai Islands attracts both end users seeking a calmer coastal lifestyle and investors drawn to beachfront property. Property in the district is offered on a freehold basis to buyers of all nationalities, and the combination of open beaches, resort hospitality and proximity to the city's main business and tourism hubs positions the area as a premium coastal address.
